newsitem.title: USA: World Color to acquire Johnson & Hardin.
newsitem.headline: World Color to acquire Johnson & Hardin.

text.p: World Color Press Inc said on Wednesday it had agreed to acquire commercial printer Johnson & Hardin in a transaction it expected to boost earnings starting in 1998.

World Color did not release terms of the agreement, which it expected to close within the next few weeks, but in a statement the company said the transaction "is expected to be neutral to earnings in 1997 and accretive to earnings beginning in 1998."

World Color added that it will acquire Johnson & Hardin's two facilities, located in Cincinnati and Lebanon, Ohio, consisting of 450,000 square feet of manufacturing and distribution space, and a workforce of 780 employees.
World Color manages and distributes print and digital information.
